queries: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(w AS REAL) / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_rate FROM t) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_win_rate, t.record_count, t.avg_win_rate - m.mean_rate AS diff_from_mean FROM t CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (t.avg_win_rate - m.mean_rate) IS NULL, diff_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10

WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(w AS REAL) / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_rate FROM team_stats) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_win_rate, t.record_count, t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_rate AS diff_from_mean FROM team_stats t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A record with g = 0 has a missing win rate (division by zero is treated as NULL). It is skipped in the team average but still counted in record_count.
The mean is an unweighted mean of the per-team averages, not a mean over all records. Teams whose average is NULL are ignored in that mean.
Teams are grouped by team_id alone, ignoring year and league.

assumptions.assumption: Records with g = 0 are treated as missing win rates (division by zero yields NULL via NULLIF) and are ignored in the average, but still counted in the record count.
Record count is the total number of manager_half rows per team_id, including rows whose win rate is missing.
Teams are grouped by team_id alone, combining all years and leagues.
The mean across teams is an unweighted mean of per-team averages; teams whose average is NULL are ignored in that mean and sort last.

alternatives.interpretation: Record count counts only manager_half records that have a non-missing win rate (w and g non-null, g nonzero).

assumptions.assumption: Teams are grouped by team_id alone, across all years and leagues. Each team_id gets one row.

Records with g = 0 or NULL g, or NULL w, have no win rate. They are ignored in the average but still counted in record_count. A team whose records all lack a win rate has a NULL average and sorts last.
Win rate is computed with floating-point division (w * 1.0 / g) to avoid integer division.
